BluePearl Pet Hospital – serving Pinellas County.
We are located in Clearwater and serve pets in St. Petersburg, Largo, Seminole, Kenneth City, Palm Harbor, Dunedin, Indian Rocks Beach, Bay Pines, Safety Harbor, Pinellas Park and beyond.
Our reviews.
Our services.
When your pet needs emergency care, seconds count. Our team is ready to provide expert care 24/7 in case of a pet emergency. If your pet requires a veterinary specialist, we are ready for that too. Our experienced team of veterinarians, vet technicians and support staff work closely together to provide the comprehensive, compassionate care your pet needs and deserves.
Emergency
Call ahead to our 24-hour emergency vet hospital in Clearwater and let us know you’re coming. No appointment is necessary. Learn more about
your emergency visit
.
Specialty care
Specialists at BluePearl veterinary hospitals work directly with your primary care vet to understand your pet’s condition and develop the appropriate treatment plan. Visits to our specialists are usually by referral from your primary care vet and by appointment. Learn more about
veterinary specialists
.

About BluePearl Pet Hospital Clearwater.
Our spacious 17,000 square foot Clearwater location is well-equipped to serve your pet with two surgical suites, nine exam rooms and diagnostic equipment including x-rays and more.
Pet owners
At BluePearl Pet Hospitals, providing our customers with remarkable service is a top priority. We’re committed to making your veterinary visit as smooth as possible.

Read about
Nicole’s experience
as an owner of three feline blood donors – Luna, Sebastian and Jack.
When my 2 year old macaw, Layla, swallowed her feeding tube whole I panicked! My local veterinarian office could not handle exotics, so I high tailed it from Plant City to Clearwater to get her to BluePearl, as they had an avian DVM on call. As soon as I arrived, Layla was whisked into the hospital.
The staff were amazing. From the folks at the desk, the nursing staff, and the vet, each one caring and forthcoming with information regarding our beloved Layla’s care.
They skillfully sedated her and retrieved the tube from her crop. I could not be more impressed with the professionalism and compassion that I experienced.
Thank you all for your skill and expertise! Layla is back to her old self.
—Dave C.
“The staff at BluePearl did a amazing job taking care of both our pups! Thank you for all you do!!”
–Paula G.
